text:
olivia: Noticing a weird spike in duplicate invoices in NetSuite this morning. Roughly 12 invoices duplicated for the same Stripe payment ids.

sam: Which integration path? webhook -> transform -> netsuite-push or the nightly re-sync job?

olivia: Looks like webhook path. Example payment: pi_3L0xyz had two NS invoices INV-908 and INV-909. Stripe shows one successful payment.

diego: I traced our webhook consumer. Stripe sent `payment_intent.succeeded` once but our delivery log shows two deliveries: original and a retry. The retry came after our service returned 202, because a downstream timeout caused Stripe to think it failed.

diego: logs:
```
[2026-04-07T07:22:11Z] stripe-delivery evt_pi_3L0xyz status=delivered http_status=202
[2026-04-07T07:22:13Z] stripe-retry evt_pi_3L0xyz status=retry attempt=1
```

billing-bot: alert: webhook-delivery-retry detected for evt_pi_3L0xyz (retry_count=1).

sam: Our transform service assigns an idempotency token `invoice_{customer.id}_{date}`. If the retry hits after midnight UTC, the date suffix changes and we happily create a second invoice.

olivia: That's the pattern. The duplicates all have adjacent timestamps crossing 00:00 UTC boundary.

diego: Quick fix: switch idempotency to include the Stripe event id `evt.id` and payment id, not a derived date. I'll open a hotfix PR.

sam: Also add defensive check in NetSuite push: if an invoice with the same stripe_payment_id already exists, do not create another; instead log and attach a note.

finance: Please don't run any automatic deletes. We need to reconcile and contact impacted customers before reversing anything.

olivia: I'll assemble an impacted-customers.csv and run a non-destructive dedupe report.

diego: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-transform/pull/320 adds `stripe_event_id` into the idempotency key and a preflight duplicate check in the NetSuite adapter. Includes unit tests that simulate midnight crossover.

sam: Nice. Add an integration test for the retry behavior and include the payloads (original + retry) in the test fixtures.

diego: Will do. Also adding a small migration script that flags duplicate invoices created between 2026-04-07T00:00:00Z and 2026-04-07T08:00:00Z for manual review. It writes a CSV and does not touch NetSuite objects.

billing-bot: deploy: staging billing-transform v1.15.0 started by diego

diego: Staging results: processed 1500 events incl simulated retries. Dedup logic prevented creation of new invoice on retry. Preflight check logs show 3 historical duplicates detected (reported to finance).

finance: Good. We'll review the CSV and approve a reversal approach for customers who were overcharged. For others we'll issue credits.

olivia: Ops, please pause the NetSuite create queue for billing until we deploy to prod.

billing-bot: queue: netsuite-create paused for billing by ops

ops: Paused starting 07:55 UTC, will monitor for 1.5 hours.

sam: Once hotfix is merged, please run staging backfill in dry-run mode on prod snapshot and post the results in this thread.

diego: Will do. Thanks everyone.
